title: ‘We Have to Prove Democracy Still Works’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些未经修饰、直言不讳的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily, today.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》今日节目。

sentences.en: During his first address to Congress, President Biden makes the case for vastly expanding the role of government and taxing the country's wealthiest to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 在首次向国会发表讲话期间，拜登总统提出要大幅扩大政府职能，并向国内最富有的人征税以支付相关费用。

sentences.en: We watched with our colleague, White House reporter Jim Tankersley.
sentences.zh: 我们与同事、白宫记者吉姆·坦克斯利一起观看了这场演讲。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月29日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Jim, I want to start this conversation by getting something very important out of the way immediately.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，我想先解决一个非常重要的问题，开启我们的对话。

sentences.en: Was this technically a State of the Union address, or was this not a State of the Union address?
sentences.zh: 这在技术上算是国情咨文演讲吗？还是说它不是？

sentences.en: And can we just call it the State of the Union, even if it's not?
sentences.zh: 即使它不是，我们能直接称之为国情咨文吗？

sentences.en: No, I believe we are prohibited by the Constitution from calling it a State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为宪法禁止我们称其为国情咨文。

sentences.en: This was an address to a joint session of Congress, but not an official State of the Union, as is typically the case in a president's first year in office.
sentences.zh: 这是一次对国会联席会议的演讲，而不是正式的国情咨文，总统任期的第一年通常都是这样。

sentences.en: So the first one, not State of the Union, instead, just big, important speech to Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一次，不是国情咨文，而是一次对国会发表的重要演讲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Joe Biden's been president for almost 100 days, but what he's doing here is less of a
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登担任总统已近100天，但他在这里所做的与其说是

sentences.en: report to the country on how the country is doing and more of a report to the country on how things are going in that very young administration of his.
sentences.zh: 向全国报告国家的发展状况，不如说是向全国报告他那非常年轻的政府目前的进展。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what this speech looked like and felt like in the room.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们来谈谈这场演讲在现场看起来和感觉上是怎样的。

sentences.en: I know neither of us were there, but it feels like these speeches are always defined by the moment in which they are delivered.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们俩都不在现场，但感觉这类演讲总是由发表时的环境所定义的。

sentences.en: And this one had the context of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而这次演讲有着疫情的背景。

sentences.en: This was the first joint address from the president to Congress since the pandemic really began to radically alter all of our lives in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是自疫情真正开始从根本上改变我们在美国的所有生活以来，总统首次向国会发表联席演讲。

sentences.en: So how present did that all feel?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种感觉有多强烈？

sentences.en: It was kind of weird.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点奇怪。

sentences.en: You know, the seats were not full because of COVID restrictions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，由于新冠防疫限制，座位并没有坐满。

sentences.en: There were only 200 people instead of the normal 1,600 for a speech like this.
sentences.zh: 现场只有200人，而不是此类演讲通常的1600人。

sentences.en: They were all spaced out at distance and there weren't as many cabinet members.
sentences.zh: 他们都保持着社交距离，内阁成员也没有那么多。

sentences.en: There weren't as many Supreme Court justices.
sentences.zh: 最高法院大法官也没有那么多。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，美国总统。

sentences.en: A Congress that is normally sort of jockeying for position to, you know, greet the president as he
sentences.zh: 通常那种争相位置去迎接总统的国会，

sentences.en: walks down the aisle, you know, looked sparse, like, like, you know, the crowd at the NBA finals bubble last year when there really were very few people around.
sentences.zh: 当他走过过道时，看起来很稀疏，就像去年NBA总决赛泡泡赛区的观众一样，周围确实没几个人。

sentences.en: And it made for some weird moments.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一些奇怪的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, Biden was walking down and he's like sort of fist bumping people, not shaking hands like, like politicians expect.
sentences.zh: 你知道，拜登走过来时，他是在和人碰拳，而不是像政客们预期的那样握手。

sentences.en: Certainly, like I would think that Joe Biden had not imagined in his mind all those years.
sentences.zh: 当然，我想乔·拜登这些年来在脑海中肯定没有预想过这些。

sentences.en: He's been envisioning himself president.
sentences.zh: 他一直设想着自己成为总统的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And then punctuating all that, there was certainly not a normal backdrop for him as he took the lecture and flanked for the first time ever by two women.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切的衬托下，当他走上讲台时，背景确实不寻常，他有史以来第一次被两位女性簇拥着。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which he went out of his way to memorialize.
sentences.zh: 他特意提到了这一点以示纪念。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他确实提到了。

sentences.en: Anyway, thank you all.
sentences.zh: 总之，谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Madam Speaker, Madam Vice President.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，副总统女士。

sentences.en: He seemed really fired up by that particular line that kicked off the speech.
sentences.zh: 他似乎对那句开启演讲的开场白感到非常振奋。

sentences.en: No president has ever said those words from this podium.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一位总统在这个讲台上说过这些话。

sentences.en: No president has ever said those words.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一位总统说过这些话。

sentences.en: And it's about time.
sentences.zh: 是时候了。

sentences.en: Then he settles into the actual thing that presidents always do at the start of a speech to Congress, which is to tell them how things are going in the country, really.
sentences.zh: 然后他进入了总统在国会演讲开始时总是会做的正事，那就是告诉他们国家目前的状况。

sentences.en: And usually that's very positive.
sentences.zh: 通常那是非常积极的。

sentences.en: Now, after just 100 days, I can report to the nation.
sentences.zh: 现在，在仅仅100天之后，我可以向全国报告。

sentences.en: America is on the move again.
sentences.zh: 美国又开始前进了。

sentences.en: And in sort of quick and staccato phrases that will sort of mark this speech throughout the evening, he says, crisis to opportunity, setbacks in the strength.
sentences.zh: 他用一些简短而断续的短语贯穿了整个晚上的演讲，他说，从危机到机遇，从挫折到力量。

sentences.en: We all know life can knock us down, but in America, we never, ever, ever stay down.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道生活会把我们击倒，但在美国，我们绝不会、绝不会、绝不会一蹶不振。

sentences.en: The president tried to do a delicate two-step, which is to both acknowledge the gravity of the moment that America is still in.
sentences.zh: 总统试图进行一种微妙的平衡，既要承认美国目前所处时刻的严重性。

sentences.en: I mean, there's still a deadly pandemic raging around us.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们周围仍然有致命的疫情在肆虐。

sentences.en: There's still more work to do to beat this virus.
sentences.zh: 要战胜这种病毒，还有更多工作要做。

sentences.en: We can't let our guard down.
sentences.zh: 我们不能掉以轻心。

sentences.en: While also trying to claim credit for putting the worst of that pandemic, hopefully, behind us.
sentences.zh: 同时也试图为我们希望已经度过了疫情最糟糕的时期而邀功。

sentences.en: Our progress these past 100 days against one of the worst pandemics in history has been one of the
sentences.zh: 过去100天里，我们对抗历史上最严重的疫情之一所取得的进展，是这个国家有史以来

sentences.en: greatest logistical achievements, logistical achievements this country's ever seen.
sentences.zh: 最伟大的后勤成就之一，后勤成就。

sentences.en: And Jim, while the president touched on a variety of items in this speech, foreign and domestic,
sentences.zh: 吉姆，虽然总统在这次演讲中谈到了各种各样的议题，包括外交和内政，

sentences.en: restrictions on guns that he would like to get passed, immigration reform he would like to get done, his determination to stand up to authoritarian regimes overseas.
sentences.zh: 他希望通过的枪支限制，他希望完成的移民改革，他对抗海外威权政权的决心。

sentences.en: It very much felt like the real focus of this address.
sentences.zh: 这确实感觉像是这次演讲的真正重点。

sentences.en: And what I want to talk to you about was President Biden's vision for the role of American government.
sentences.zh: 我想和你谈谈拜登总统对美国政府角色的愿景。

sentences.en: And it's a very expansive vision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常宏大的愿景。

sentences.en: And that's what he really seemed to be up to in this speech.
sentences.zh: 这似乎正是他在这次演讲中想要表达的。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: This was a an economic policy speech, but more than a policy speech, it was selling America on the idea that, hey, the government is back.
sentences.zh: 这是一场经济政策演讲，但不仅仅是政策演讲，它是在向美国兜售一个理念，即：嘿，政府回来了。

sentences.en: Big government spending initiatives are back and bigger government even than we have now is on the way.
sentences.zh: 大型政府支出计划回来了，而且比我们现在拥有的政府规模还要大。

sentences.en: And it's going to be really great for you personally.
sentences.zh: 这对你个人来说将是非常棒的。

sentences.en: And he does this sort of looking backwards and forwards.
sentences.zh: 他通过回顾过去和展望未来来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Throughout our history, if you think about it, public investment in infrastructure has literally transformed America.
sentences.zh: 纵观我们的历史，如果你想一想，对基础设施的公共投资确实改变了美国。

sentences.en: He ticks through the great achievements of the federal government in American history.
sentences.zh: 他列举了美国历史上联邦政府的伟大成就。

sentences.en: The Transcontinental Railroad, the interstate highways, united two oceans and brought a totally new age of progress to the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 横贯大陆铁路、州际公路，连接了两大洋，并为美利坚合众国带来了全新的进步时代。

sentences.en: Whether it's World War II or railroads or, you know, the space race.
sentences.zh: 无论是二战、铁路，还是太空竞赛。

sentences.en: These are investments we made together as one country.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们作为一个国家共同进行的投资。

sentences.en: And investments that only the government was in a position to make.
sentences.zh: 而且是只有政府才有能力进行的投资。

sentences.en: Time and again, they propel us into the future.
sentences.zh: 它们一次又一次地推动我们走向未来。

sentences.en: That's why I proposed the American Jobs Plan.
sentences.zh: 这就是我提出《美国就业计划》的原因。

sentences.en: A once in a generation investment in America itself.
sentences.zh: 这是对美国本身一代人一次的投资。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to spend the bulk of the speech, really, laying out his vision for America's
sentences.zh: 然后他继续花费演讲的大部分时间，真正阐述他对美国

sentences.en: economic future, which is really two proposals that total $4 trillion in the cost to taxpayers and form the Biden economic agenda.
sentences.zh: 经济未来的愿景，这实际上是两项提案，总计4万亿美元的纳税人成本，构成了拜登的经济议程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Jim, you have talked to us on the show about the first part of that plan, the American Jobs Plan, this very progressive version of what we might think of as traditional
sentences.zh: 吉姆，你在节目中和我们谈过该计划的第一部分，即《美国就业计划》，这是我们可能认为的传统

sentences.en: infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 基础设施的一个非常进步的版本。

sentences.en: Rebuilding bridges, roads, pipes, railroads, housing in a way that seeks, in Biden's words, to fight climate change and achieve racial justice.
sentences.zh: 重建桥梁、道路、管道、铁路、住房，用拜登的话说，旨在应对气候变化并实现种族正义。

sentences.en: So how does he talk about this not-yet-passed component of his agenda?
sentences.zh: 那么他是如何谈论他议程中这个尚未通过的部分的呢？

sentences.en: I was really struck, actually, by his focus in talking about that part of the agenda and his just repeated use of the word jobs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他谈论议程那部分时的专注，以及他反复使用“就业”这个词，真的让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: This is the largest jobs plan since World War II.
sentences.zh: 这是自二战以来最大的就业计划。

sentences.en: Jobs, jobs, jobs.
sentences.zh: 就业，就业，就业。

sentences.en: Creates jobs to upgrade our transportation infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 创造就业机会以升级我们的交通基础设施。

sentences.en: Jobs modernizing our roads, bridges, highways.
sentences.zh: 就业机会，使我们的道路、桥梁、高速公路现代化。

sentences.en: Jobs building ports and everything.
sentences.zh: 就业机会，建设港口等等。

sentences.en: He is talking about every single piece of that physical infrastructure agenda as a job creator, the biggest job creator since World War II.
sentences.zh: 他把那个实体基础设施议程的每一项都称为就业创造者，这是自二战以来最大的就业创造者。

sentences.en: For too long, we've failed to use the most important word when it comes to meeting the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，在应对气候危机时，我们未能使用最重要的词汇。

sentences.en: Jobs.
sentences.zh: 就业。

sentences.en: And not just any jobs.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是任何工作。

sentences.en: Blue-collar jobs.
sentences.zh: 蓝领工作。

sentences.en: So many of you, so many of the folks I grew up with, feel left behind, forgotten, in an economy that's so rapidly changing.
sentences.zh: 你们中的许多人，我一起长大的许多人，在这样一个快速变化的经济中感到被抛弃、被遗忘。

sentences.en: It's frightening.
sentences.zh: 这很可怕。

sentences.en: And he is really trying to speak to voters without college degrees who've been left behind by the economy, who he says he can create better-paying, good jobs for.
sentences.zh: 他真的在试图与那些没有大学学位、被经济抛弃的选民对话，他说他可以为他们创造薪水更高、更好的工作。

sentences.en: The American Jobs Plan is a blue-collar blueprint to build America.
sentences.zh: 《美国就业计划》是建设美国的蓝领蓝图。

sentences.en: That's what it is.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的意义所在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Windmills should be built in Pittsburgh, not Beijing.
sentences.zh: 风车应该在匹兹堡制造，而不是北京。

sentences.en: There is simply no reason why the blades for wind turbines can't be built in Pittsburgh instead of
sentences.zh: 风力涡轮机的叶片完全没有理由不能在匹兹堡制造，而不是在

sentences.en: Beijing.
sentences.zh: 北京。

sentences.en: No reason.
sentences.zh: 没有理由。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, this is Biden trying to take that progressive vision of a low-carbon future, but say it in sort of, you know, Joe from Scranton terMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是拜登试图采纳那种低碳未来的进步愿景，但用斯克兰顿的乔那种方式表达出来。

sentences.en: And all the investments in the American Job Plan will be guided by one principle.
sentences.zh: 《美国就业计划》中的所有投资都将遵循一个原则。

sentences.en: Buy American.
sentences.zh: 购买美国货。

sentences.en: Buy American.
sentences.zh: 购买美国货。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: His message being, especially to Republicans, how could you not support a jobs plan?
sentences.zh: 他传达的信息，特别是对共和党人而言，你怎么能不支持一个就业计划呢？

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: Republicans might look at this plan and say, actually, we think it's a climate plan and a social justice plan.
sentences.zh: 共和党人可能会看这个计划并说，实际上，我们认为这是一个气候计划和社会正义计划。

sentences.en: But what Biden is saying is, no, I'm telling you that it's a jobs plan and asking how you could possibly not support it.
sentences.zh: 但拜登所说的是，不，我告诉你这是一个就业计划，并问你怎么可能不支持它。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's exactly what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 这正是他正在做的。

sentences.en: And yes, Republicans are protesting that there are studies out there showing that it won't create many jobs or any at all.
sentences.zh: 是的，共和党人抗议说有一些研究表明它不会创造多少就业机会，甚至根本不会创造。

sentences.en: But Biden is just blowing right past all that criticism and saying millions of jobs, good paying jobs.
sentences.zh: 但拜登直接忽略了所有这些批评，说数百万个就业机会，高薪的就业机会。

sentences.en: That's what this proposal is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是这项提案的全部意义所在。

sentences.en: And Congress needs to pass it now.
sentences.zh: 国会现在需要通过它。

sentences.en: And so what's the truth?
sentences.zh: 那么真相是什么？

sentences.en: Will this bill create jobs?
sentences.zh: 这项法案会创造就业机会吗？

sentences.en: It really depends on which study you look at.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于你看的是哪项研究。

sentences.en: There are some studies that say it'll create millions of jobs.
sentences.zh: 有些研究说它会创造数百万个就业机会。

sentences.en: There's one pretty notable one that says it won't.
sentences.zh: 有一个相当著名的研究说它不会。

sentences.en: And so the experts disagree.
sentences.zh: 所以专家们的意见不一致。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And then Biden turns to the second part of this grand infrastructure spending plan, which we had not really gotten much of a glimpse of until the speech.
sentences.zh: 然后拜登转向了这个宏大基础设施支出计划的第二部分，在演讲之前我们并没有真正看到太多端倪。

sentences.en: To win that competition for the future, in my view, we also need to make a once in a generation investment in our families and our children.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，为了赢得未来的竞争，我们还需要对我们的家庭和孩子进行一代人一次的投资。

sentences.en: That's why I've introduced the American Families Plan tonight.
sentences.zh: 这就是我今晚提出《美国家庭计划》的原因。

sentences.en: So this is what the White
sentences.zh: 所以这就是白宫所说的

sentences.en: House calls the American Families Plan, which is a different sort of infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 《美国家庭计划》，这是一种不同类型的基础设施。

sentences.en: It's human infrastructure about people.
sentences.zh: 它是关于人的“人力基础设施”。

sentences.en: And it breaks down into several categories.
sentences.zh: 它分为几个类别。

sentences.en: It's $1.8 trillion split between spending and tax incentives.
sentences.zh: 这是1.8万亿美元，分配在支出和税收激励之间。

sentences.en: First is access to good education.
sentences.zh: 首先是获得良好的教育。

sentences.en: So there's an education component, which includes free universal preschool for three and four-year-olds across the country,
sentences.zh: 所以有一个教育部分，其中包括为全国三岁和四岁儿童提供免费的普及学前教育，

sentences.en: but also two years of free community college for anybody.
sentences.zh: 同时也为任何人提供两年的免费社区大学教育。

sentences.en: American Families Plan will provide access to quality, affordable child care.
sentences.zh: “美国家庭计划”将提供普及且负担得起的优质托儿服务。

sentences.en: It includes help for child care, so to reduce the cost of child care, particularly for low-income workers, but also paid family and medical leave so that workers
sentences.zh: 它包括对托儿服务的支持，旨在降低托儿成本，特别是针对低收入劳动者，同时也包括带薪家庭假和病假，这样劳动者

sentences.en: who get sick or need to take care of a loved one who's sick can do so but not lose their jobs or their income.
sentences.zh: 在生病或需要照顾生病的亲人时，可以请假而不会失去工作或收入。

sentences.en: And that's paid by the government.
sentences.zh: 而且这些费用由政府承担。

sentences.en: In March, we expanded tax credit for every child and a family.
sentences.zh: 三月份，我们扩大了针对每个孩子和家庭的税收抵免。

sentences.en: And then it extends a bunch of tax credits that are meant to fight poverty, including
sentences.zh: 随后，该计划又延长了一系列旨在消除贫困的税收抵免政策，包括

sentences.en: an expansion of the child tax credit that the White House estimates will cut the child poverty rate in half.
sentences.zh: 扩大儿童税收抵免，白宫预计这将使儿童贫困率减半。

sentences.en: We can afford it.
sentences.zh: 我们负担得起。

sentences.en: And as he has often done in selling his physical infrastructure plan,
sentences.zh: 正如他在推销其基础设施计划时经常做的那样，

sentences.en: Biden casts this Families Plan in competitiveness terMs. When this nation made 12 years of public
sentences.zh: 拜登从竞争力的角度阐述了这项“家庭计划”。上个世纪，当这个国家实现12年义务

sentences.en: education universal in the last century, it made us the best-educated, best-prepared nation in the world.
sentences.zh: 普及教育时，我们成为了世界上受教育程度最高、准备最充分的国家。

sentences.en: It's, I believe, the overwhelming region that propelled us to where we got in the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 我相信，这正是推动我们在20世纪取得成就的最主要原因。

sentences.en: But the world's caught up or catching up.
sentences.zh: 但世界已经赶上或正在赶上来。

sentences.en: They're not waiting.
sentences.zh: 他们不会坐等。

sentences.en: Basically saying, look, if we don't invest in our families, our children, our workers, just like we invest in our roads, bridges, pipes,
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，看，如果我们不投资于我们的家庭、孩子和劳动者，就像我们投资于道路、桥梁、管道、

sentences.en: charging stations, whatever, we're not going to keep up with China and our other big competitors on a global scale right now to win the economic future of the world.
sentences.zh: 充电站等设施一样，我们就无法在当前的全球范围内与中国和其他主要竞争对手并驾齐驱，从而赢得世界的经济未来。

sentences.en: I wonder if you can put the scale of all this, the education spending, the child care spending, the paid leave spending, the child tax credit spending, into context for us.
sentences.zh: 我想请你为我们梳理一下这一切的规模，包括教育支出、托儿支出、带薪假支出和儿童税收抵免支出。

sentences.en: I think the best context to put it in is that it's unprecedented at this moment in the nation's economy for a president to do this.
sentences.zh: 我认为最好的背景是，在当前国家经济形势下，总统采取这样的举措是史无前例的。

sentences.en: We do not have the same economy that we had when we did the space race or when we built the railroads or won World War II.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的经济状况与我们进行太空竞赛、修建铁路或赢得二战时已大不相同。

sentences.en: We have an economy that depends to a much larger degree on women working, on workers of color, and in particular on service workers who need
sentences.zh: 我们的经济在更大程度上依赖于女性就业、有色人种劳动者，特别是那些需要

sentences.en: knowledge and skills to do their jobs better.
sentences.zh: 知识和技能来更好地完成工作的服务业人员。

sentences.en: This is a far bigger spending agenda than Barack Obama ever proposed, certainly much bigger than the Democratic president beforehand, Bill Clinton, proposed.
sentences.zh: 这比巴拉克·奥巴马曾经提出的支出议程要宏大得多，当然也比之前的民主党总统比尔·克林顿提出的方案规模大得多。

sentences.en: And so what you have is, for the first time, the meeting of the moment of what Democrats
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的是，民主党人第一次将他们

sentences.en: think is a renewed interest in big government with the heightened struggles of a 21st century economy.
sentences.zh: 认为对大政府的重新关注，与21世纪经济中日益严峻的挑战结合在了一起。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，你会不会想探索一下？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费使用第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载时报应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So how does President Biden in this speech talk about financing all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么拜登总统在演讲中是如何谈论这一切的资金来源的呢？

sentences.en: He does not shy from that either.
sentences.zh: 他对此也毫不避讳。

sentences.en: How do we pay for my jobs and family plan?
sentences.zh: 我们如何为我的就业和家庭计划买单？

sentences.en: I made it clear
sentences.zh: 我明确表示过

sentences.en: we can do it without increasing the deficits.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在不增加赤字的情况下做到这一点。

sentences.en: There's been a long time in America where this idea was you couldn't really talk about increasing taxes.
sentences.zh: 在美国，长期以来有一种观点认为，你不能真正谈论增加税收。

sentences.en: It would be political suicide.
sentences.zh: 那将是政治自杀。

sentences.en: But he goes right at it.
sentences.zh: 但他直接面对了这个问题。

sentences.en: I will not impose any tax increase on people making less than $400,000.
sentences.zh: 我不会对收入低于40万美元的人增加任何税收。

sentences.en: But it's time for corporate America.
sentences.zh: 但现在是美国企业界承担责任的时候了。

sentences.en: And the wealthiest 1% of Americans have just begun to pay their fair share.
sentences.zh: 最富有的1%美国人也才刚刚开始缴纳他们应缴的那份税款。

sentences.en: And basically says we're going to raise taxes on very high earners, people making more than $400,000
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，我们要对高收入者，即年收入超过40万美元的人加税，

sentences.en: a year, which is just a small sliver at the top of Americans by income earning and corporations.
sentences.zh: 这只是美国收入最高的一小部分群体，以及企业。

sentences.en: And we're going to get $4 trillion out of those two places.
sentences.zh: 我们要从这两个渠道筹集4万亿美元。

sentences.en: A lot of companies also evade taxes through tax havens in Switzerland and Bermuda and the Cayman Islands.
sentences.zh: 许多公司还通过瑞士、百慕大和开曼群岛等避税天堂逃税。

sentences.en: And they benefit from tax loopholes and deductions for offshoring jobs and shifting profits overseas.
sentences.zh: 他们利用税收漏洞和扣除额将工作外包，并将利润转移到海外。

sentences.en: And then he ticked through a whole list of both tax increases and increased enforcement from the IRS.
sentences.zh: 随后，他列举了一系列税收增加和国税局（IRS）加强执法的措施。

sentences.en: And the IRS is going to crack down on millionaires and billionaires who cheat on their taxes.
sentences.zh: 国税局将严厉打击逃税的百万富翁和亿万富翁。

sentences.en: It's estimated to be billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 预计涉及金额达数十亿美元。

sentences.en: To force people who had been cheating on their taxes to stop.
sentences.zh: 迫使那些一直在逃税的人停止这种行为。

sentences.en: I believe what I propose is fair.
sentences.zh: 我相信我的提议是公平的。

sentences.en: Fiscally responsible.
sentences.zh: 在财政上是负责任的。

sentences.en: You know, Republicans are very much opposed to these tax increases and to the scope of the spending he wants to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，共和党人非常反对这些增税措施以及他想要实施的支出规模。

sentences.en: They're arguing that it's going to be wasteful, that it's not going to solve the problems that he says, that the government is not well positioned to tackle these
sentences.zh: 他们认为这会造成浪费，无法解决他所说的问题，政府也没有能力处理这些

sentences.en: issues, and that the tax increases are going to hurt the economy.
sentences.zh: 问题，而且增税会损害经济。

sentences.en: But Biden goes right at that argument in the speech, basically saying, trickle down.
sentences.zh: 但拜登在演讲中直接反驳了这一论点，基本上是在说“涓滴经济学”。

sentences.en: Trickle down economics has never worked.
sentences.zh: 涓滴经济学从未奏效。

sentences.en: It's time to grow the economy from the bottom in the middle out.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候从底层和中层开始发展经济了。

sentences.en: Hey, the dominant Republican philosophy for more than a generation now, trickle down economics, cutting taxes at the top and everybody will benefit, has not worked.
sentences.zh: 嘿，共和党一代人以来的主流哲学——涓滴经济学，即通过给顶层减税让所有人受益——并没有奏效。

sentences.en: The pandemic has only made things worse.
sentences.zh: 疫情只会让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: 20 million Americans lost their job in the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 疫情期间有2000万美国人失去了工作，

sentences.en: working in middle class Americans.
sentences.zh: 他们是工薪阶层和中产阶级美国人。

sentences.en: At the same time, roughly 650 billionaires in America saw their net worth increase by more than $1 trillion in the same exact period.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美国大约650位亿万富翁的净资产在同一时期增加了超过1万亿美元。

sentences.en: What he is saying is, we have huge long-running problems in our economy.
sentences.zh: 他想说的是，我们的经济中存在长期存在的巨大问题。

sentences.en: The pandemic showed us those probleMs. They showed us the people who were hit unequally.
sentences.zh: 疫情向我们展示了这些问题。它向我们展示了哪些人受到的冲击是不平等的。

sentences.en: You know, some people at the top amassed huge amounts of wealth while everybody else feared for job loss.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一些顶层人士积累了巨额财富，而其他人却在担心失业。

sentences.en: And it's government's job now to start solving those problems or helping to solve those problems, not just in a short-term way, but in a long-term durable way.
sentences.zh: 现在政府的工作是开始解决这些问题，或者帮助解决这些问题，不仅是短期内，而且要以长期、持久的方式。

sentences.en: And someone needs to pay for that.
sentences.zh: 而且总得有人为此买单。

sentences.en: And that someone is the people who have been winning at this economy for a long time, the rich and big companies.
sentences.zh: 而那个人就是长期以来在经济中获利的人，即富人和大公司。

sentences.en: And so it's this economic argument, which he calls middle out, where the people who are the big successes in the
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他所谓的“中层向外”的经济论点，即那些在经济中取得巨大成功的人

sentences.en: economy can afford to supply the money to help everybody else have a shot at success too.
sentences.zh: 有能力提供资金，帮助其他人也有机会获得成功。

sentences.en: Jim, it was interesting that Biden didn't really talk about inequality.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，有趣的是拜登并没有真正谈论“不平等”。

sentences.en: He didn't use that word.
sentences.zh: 他没有使用这个词。

sentences.en: He didn't render that judgment, say that what's wrong in the United States is inequality.
sentences.zh: 他没有做出那种判断，没有说美国的问题在于不平等。

sentences.en: But the policies he's talking about are very clearly intended to fix inequality in the system.
sentences.zh: 但他所谈论的政策显然旨在解决系统中的不平等问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, he does more of a show, don't tell on that.
sentences.zh: 是的，他在这一点上做得更多的是“展示，而非诉说”。

sentences.en: He talks about the 600-plus very wealthy people who amassed huge wealth during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了在危机期间积累了巨额财富的600多位超级富豪。

sentences.en: And then he talks about the people who lost their jobs.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到了那些失去工作的人。

sentences.en: He talks about all of these sort of like inequalities, you might say, without really saying the word.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了所有这些你可能会说是不平等的东西，但并没有真正说出这个词。

sentences.en: And it's a way to sort of try to connect with people where they are in their homes.
sentences.zh: 这是一种试图与人们在他们家中产生共鸣的方式。

sentences.en: Like inequality is a concept, but your job, what you observe around you in the economy, that's real.
sentences.zh: 不平等是一个概念，但你的工作，你在经济中观察到的周围事物，那才是真实的。

sentences.en: And I think that's what he's trying to do here, is speak about inequality in much more personal terms, as opposed to theoretical or even just broad macroeconomic terMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是他在这里试图做的，即以更个人的方式谈论不平等，而不是以理论的或仅仅是宏观经济的术语来谈论。

sentences.en: But I wonder if this is also a way to appeal to Republicans who have not been very supportive of Biden's spending plans.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这是否也是一种吸引那些一直不太支持拜登支出计划的共和党人的方式。

sentences.en: I don't think there's very much that the president did in the speech to try to appeal to Republicans in Congress.
sentences.zh: 我不认为总统在演讲中做了多少努力去争取国会中的共和党人。

sentences.en: But I do think he's trying to appeal to Republicans across the country.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为他是在试图争取全国各地的共和党人。

sentences.en: He's trying to speak in the language of blue-collar, often conservative America, even if he doesn't expect that that's going to translate into any votes from Republicans
sentences.zh: 他试图用蓝领、通常是保守派美国的语言来表达，即使他不指望这会转化为共和党人

sentences.en: in the Senate or in the House.
sentences.zh: 在参议院或众议院的任何选票。

sentences.en: But by trying to appeal to Republican voters, he's giving some cover to moderate Democratic senators to join him.
sentences.zh: 但通过试图吸引共和党选民，他为温和派民主党参议员加入他的阵营提供了一些掩护。

sentences.en: If you're Joe Manchin, if you're
sentences.zh: 如果你是乔·曼钦，如果你是

sentences.en: Mark Kelly of Arizona or Kyrsten Sinema of Arizona, and you need some Republicans to reelect
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的马克·凯利或克里斯滕·希内马，并且你需要一些共和党人来让你连任，

sentences.en: you, here's Joe Biden speaking to those voters for you and giving you some permission to go along with him.
sentences.zh: 那么乔·拜登正在为你向这些选民喊话，并给予你支持他的许可。

sentences.en: So in trying to appeal to Republican voters, he's actually just trying to keep the 50 Democrats in the Senate, the Democratic caucus, together and supporting both
sentences.zh: 所以，在试图吸引共和党选民的同时，他实际上只是在努力保持参议院50名民主党人、民主党核心小组的团结，并支持

sentences.en: of these major infrastructure bills.
sentences.zh: 这两项主要的基建法案。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What Biden needs for any bill of this type to pass, including one that eventually might get bipartisan support, is for all Democrats to hang together.
sentences.zh: 拜登要让任何此类法案获得通过，包括最终可能获得两党支持的法案，都需要所有民主党人团结一致。

sentences.en: And that, I think, was a big part of the mission of the speech here, was to hold his very, very narrow margins in the House and the
sentences.zh: 我认为，这正是此次演讲使命的重要组成部分，即在他寻求推动议程时，稳住他在众议院和

sentences.en: Senate, kind of in line, while he seeks to push the agenda through.
sentences.zh: 参议院非常、非常微弱的多数优势。

sentences.en: Jim, watching Biden outline these proposals and how to pay for them, I kept thinking back to the
sentences.zh: 吉姆，看着拜登概述这些提案以及如何为它们买单，我不断回想起

sentences.en: election and to this sense that, in choosing Biden, the country chose what Biden himself advertised as
sentences.zh: 选举，以及这样一种感觉：在选择拜登时，国家选择了拜登本人所宣扬的

sentences.en: the return to normalcy in the conduct and in the disposition of the president.
sentences.zh: 总统行为和作风的“回归常态”。

sentences.en: And as a kind of safe ideological choice, Biden sold himself as a moderate Democrat with pretty middle-of-the-road views.
sentences.zh: 作为一种安全的意识形态选择，拜登将自己包装成一个观点相当中庸的温和派民主党人。

sentences.en: But as we have seen at a few key junctures with Biden since the election, it feels like this speech marked the emergence of a distinctly progressive president.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们自选举以来在拜登身上看到的几个关键节点一样，感觉这次演讲标志着一位鲜明的进步派总统的出现。

sentences.en: A president that is seeking to really expand the role of government as a leveler of the field, as an equalizer, as a fixer of social wrongs.
sentences.zh: 一位寻求真正扩大政府作用，将其作为公平竞争的推动者、平等主义者和社会弊病的修复者的总统。

sentences.en: And that's not exactly who we necessarily thought we were going to be getting.
sentences.zh: 这并不完全是我们之前认为我们会得到的总统。

sentences.en: Well, here's the sort of wild thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里有一个疯狂的地方。

sentences.en: Almost every policy proposal on the economy that Joe Biden laid out in the speech, he campaigned on.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在演讲中提出的几乎每一项经济政策建议，都是他在竞选时承诺过的。

sentences.en: This is not new.
sentences.zh: 这不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: Some of it dates back to 2019.
sentences.zh: 其中一些可以追溯到2019年。

sentences.en: Some of the stuff he was talking about when nobody really gave him much of a shot to be the Democratic nominee, it got kind of
sentences.zh: 当没人真正看好他能成为民主党提名人时，他谈论的一些东西被掩盖了，

sentences.en: buried because so many of his rivals, almost all of them really, were much more progressive than he was.
sentences.zh: 因为他的许多竞争对手，几乎所有人，都比他进步得多。

sentences.en: They were pushing even bigger tax increases, even bigger spending increases.
sentences.zh: 他们推动的增税幅度更大，支出增加也更多。

sentences.en: In that field, Joe Biden really was moderate.
sentences.zh: 在那个阵营中，乔·拜登确实是温和派。

sentences.en: In the context of American history, Joe Biden is pushing a very progressive agenda.
sentences.zh: 在美国历史的背景下，乔·拜登正在推动一项非常进步的议程。

sentences.en: But it's all on brand for him because he's been talking about it all along.
sentences.zh: 但这对他来说完全符合他的一贯风格，因为他一直都在谈论这些。

sentences.en: And the way he talks about it is different than the way that other politicians talk about it who are progressive.
sentences.zh: 而且他谈论这些的方式与那些进步派的其他政治家谈论的方式不同。

sentences.en: And so I think all that has come together.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这一切都融合在一起了。

sentences.en: So both things are true.
sentences.zh: 所以这两点都是事实。

sentences.en: It is both true that this is seems to a lot of people, and particularly to Republicans, like, whoa, not the Joe Biden we thought we were getting.
sentences.zh: 一方面，很多人，特别是共和党人，觉得“哇，这不是我们以为会得到的乔·拜登”。

sentences.en: We thought he'd govern in a different way.
sentences.zh: 我们以为他会以不同的方式执政。

sentences.en: But for anybody who was reading the details of his plans, he's very consistent.
sentences.zh: 但对于任何阅读过他计划细节的人来说，他非常一致。

sentences.en: Are you telling me I wasn't reading the plans?
sentences.zh: 你是说我没读过这些计划吗？

sentences.en: I'm not telling you that.
sentences.zh: 我不是那个意思。

sentences.en: I would never say that.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会那样说。

sentences.en: I'm sure you read deeply into all of the 800 different policy proposals that he had on the campaign, which is the actual number.
sentences.zh: 我相信你深入阅读了他竞选时提出的800项不同政策建议，这可是实际数字。

sentences.en: In conclusion, as we gather here tonight, the image of a violent mob assaulting this Capitol, desecrating our democracy, remained vivid in all our minds.
sentences.zh: 总之，当我们今晚聚集在这里时，暴徒袭击国会大厦、亵渎我们民主的画面，依然清晰地留在我们所有人的脑海中。

sentences.en: Lives were put at risk, many of your lives.
sentences.zh: 生命受到了威胁，你们许多人的生命。

sentences.en: Lives were loSt.
sentences.zh: 生命逝去了。

sentences.en: Extraordinary courage was summoned.
sentences.zh: 非凡的勇气被唤起。

sentences.en: The insurrection was an existential crisis, a test of whether our democracy could survive.
sentences.zh: 这场叛乱是一场生存危机，是对我们的民主能否存续的考验。

sentences.en: And it did.
sentences.zh: 而它挺过来了。

sentences.en: So Jim, at the end of this speech, the president tried to do something interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以吉姆，在演讲结束时，总统试图做一件有趣的事情。

sentences.en: He touches on the riot at the Capitol on January 6th, something he did not do a lot in this speech, even though
sentences.zh: 他提到了1月6日的国会大厦骚乱，这是他在演讲中没有多谈的事情，尽管

sentences.en: he's in the building where it happened, and he's speaking to several lawmakers who are being held responsible for stoking it.
sentences.zh: 他就在事发大楼内，并且正在向几位被认为应对煽动骚乱负责的议员发表讲话。

sentences.en: And he says, They look at the images of the mob that assaulted the Capitol as proof that the sun is sending on
sentences.zh: 他说，他们将袭击国会大厦的暴徒画面视为美国民主正在走向终结的证据。

sentences.en: American democracy.
sentences.zh: 你可以将那次事件视为我们民主衰落的标志，是其功能失调的终极标志。

sentences.en: That you could see that event as a sign of the kind of decline of our democracy, the ultimate sign of its dysfunction.
sentences.zh: 但随后他似乎说，在我们共同度过的前一百天里，我们已经采取行动恢复了人们对民主能够实现目标的信心。

sentences.en: But then he seems to say, In our first hundred days together, we've acted to restore people's faith in democracy to deliver.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为全国接种疫苗。

sentences.en: We're vaccinating the nation.
sentences.zh: 我们正在创造数十万个新的就业岗位。

sentences.en: We're creating hundreds of thousands of new jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为人们带来真正的成果。

sentences.en: We're delivering real results to people.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在自己的生活中看到它，感受到它。

sentences.en: They can see it, feel it in their own lives.
sentences.zh: 他执政的前一百天证明了事实并非如此，它们是对“民主陷入困境”这一观点的反驳。

sentences.en: His first hundred days show otherwise, that they are a rebuke to the idea that the democracy is in trouble.
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: What did you make of that?
sentences.zh: 是的，他是在说政府回来了，它在1月6日的袭击考验中幸存了下来，

sentences.en: Yeah, he's saying government is back, that it's survived the test of the January 6th attacks,
sentences.zh: 它在致命疫情的考验中幸存了下来，它体现在你手臂上的疫苗针和银行账户里的刺激支票中。

sentences.en: that it has survived the test of a deadly pandemic, that it's showing up in the shot in your arm and the stimulus check in your bank account.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你再给予它一点信心，它就能完成所有这些其他大事，解决你生活中所有这些其他大问题。

sentences.en: And that if you just give it another bit of your faith, it can do all these other big things to solve all these other big problems in your life.
sentences.zh: 而证据就摆在过去一年你所见证的政府工作中。

sentences.en: And the evidence is sitting right there in the last year that you've witnessed of the government at work.
sentences.zh: 证据就摆在那里。

sentences.en: Well, Jim, thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: President Biden promised you a specific kind of leadership.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统曾向你们承诺过一种特定的领导风格。

sentences.en: He promised to unite a nation.
sentences.zh: 他承诺要团结整个国家。

sentences.en: But three months in, the actions of the president and his party are pulling us further and further apart.
sentences.zh: 但三个月过去了，总统及其政党的所作所为却让我们分歧越来越大。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, Senator Tim Scott of South Carolina delivered the Republican rebuttal to
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，南卡罗来纳州参议员蒂姆·斯科特发表了共和党对

sentences.en: Biden's speech, making the case for less government and faulting Biden for pursuing what
sentences.zh: 拜登演讲的反驳，他主张精简政府，并指责拜登推行他所称的

sentences.en: Scott called a divisive tax and spend agenda that would hurt the economy.
sentences.zh: 分裂性的征税和支出议程，这会损害经济。

sentences.en: Even more taxing, even more spending to put Washington even more in the middle of your life from the cradle to college.
sentences.zh: 更多的税收，更多的支出，让华盛顿从摇篮到大学更深地介入你的生活。

sentences.en: We should be expanding opportunities and options for all families, not throwing money at certain issues because Democrats think they know beSt.
sentences.zh: 我们应该为所有家庭扩大机会和选择，而不是因为民主党人自以为是就盲目地向某些问题砸钱。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, federal agents executed search warrants at the home and office of Rudy Giuliani,
sentences.zh: 周三，联邦探员对鲁迪·朱利安尼的住所和办公室执行了搜查令，

sentences.en: former President Trump's personal lawyer, signaling a new phase of the criminal investigation into his conduct.
sentences.zh: 他是前总统特朗普的私人律师，这标志着针对他行为的刑事调查进入了新阶段。

sentences.en: That investigation is focused on whether in 2019, Giuliani illegally lobbied the
sentences.zh: 该调查的重点是朱利安尼在2019年是否曾非法游说

sentences.en: Trump administration on behalf of Ukrainian officials and oligarchs who, at the time, were helping
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府，以代表当时正在帮助

sentences.en: Giuliani search for damaging information on Trump's political rivals, including President Biden.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼搜寻特朗普政治对手（包括拜登总统）负面信息的乌克兰官员和寡头。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration is charging three white men with federal hate crimes in the death of
sentences.zh: 拜登政府指控三名白人男子犯有联邦仇恨罪，涉及

sentences.en: Ahmaud Arbery, the 25-year-old Black man who was shot to death last year while jogging through a neighborhood in South Georgia.
sentences.zh: 阿莫德·阿伯里的死亡，这名25岁的黑人男子去年在南佐治亚州的一个社区慢跑时被枪杀。

sentences.en: According to the indictments, the three men targeted Arbery, quote, because of Arbery's race and color.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，这三名男子针对阿伯里，引用原文，“是因为阿伯里的种族和肤色”。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞秋·奎斯特制作，

sentences.zh: 埃里克·克鲁普克、杰西卡·钟和莱斯利·戴维斯参与制作。

sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周和佩奇·考维特编辑，克里斯·伍德负责工程。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。
